rows.TEXT:
Geintel 
"Must we linger another year before he arrives? All of this waiting delays our conquest! We all know what message he brings!"

Serphis 
"You should not presume to know Gallean's will so well Geintel."

Geintel 
"Has your rise in rank weakened you so? Why would he avoid vengeance upon those who have wounded him? Our forces are strong and our journey brings us right into the Clans' domain. You should spend less time buffing your armor, Serphis!"

Serphis 
"Perhaps...but we cannot charge blindly. We have enough enemies. Our forces are stronger but still fragile; winning these lands without losing more of our...wait...there!!!"

Serphis 
"Well met, messenger, we have been awaiting your arrival for some time now, please present your message."

Messenger 
"By Gallean's wish, through the oracle, you are to invade the northern lands by passing through Korbach's fort. The Clans have infested this area, lands that should have belonged to us! There is more...you are to show no mercy."

Serphis 
"If such is the will of our god, we must obey. We will begin our conquest at once. It appears you were right, Geintel, we are but a weapon pointed into the heart of Gallean's enemy! Ready the battalions!"

Peasant Triff 
"Damn you Elves! You're too late, though! The Empire has already sent a group of researchers to retrieve the sigil from our library."

Gardharus 
"Halt travelers! Please seek adventure elsewhere for now...our group is currently conducting...research...in the ruin here. Move along."
"Are you not the Empire's elite thieves? It seems to me like you are doing more plundering than research."

Gardharus 
"How dare you!? I am Gardharus, Assassin and Researcher extraordinaire, not one of those stealing fools from Dragnhar city!"

Gardharus 
"Silence, fool! Brin! Archibald! Take care of them!"

Brin 
"No problem. Hey, what's wrong with their ears?"

Gardharus 
"hmpf, only a minor drawback, there are still many ruins that can give me what I seek...enjoy your victory, it shall be short lived..."

Gardharus 
"No match...of course. How could you ever expect to win to the likes of me? Brin, Archibald, we still have other ruins that need to be...researched. Ha ha ha!"
"The stench of death plagues this town... what has happened here???"

Ephandill 
"Sir, upon searching the surroundings, we found several tombs that have been desecrated and emptied. The locals claim that the corpses were moved to the ruined temple of Dargoniel."
"Dargoniel? Is that not an ancient Elven ruin?"
Demariel"This city is now under our control sire! We have kept this human alive, he claims that if he is not heard, it could bring forth Gallean's fury."
"A human dares to speak on Gallean's behalf? Nonsense! Gallean's command is to destroy all who live upon these lands!"

Karasten 
"So, it is true after all...the Elves are going after the Empire?"
"Empire? Don't be ridiculous. We are simply taking back land the Dwarves owe us!"
"What a tongue on this one! Why would we fail?"

Karasten 
"Because the Demons are the real power in this area, they have one of their last remaining strongholds right here!"
"The Legions? They are supposed to be weak and scattered. They are no concern of ours!"

Karasten 
"You are wrong, they have been killing messengers from the Empire for months. Why do you think the Humans never reached you? The real threat lies at the foot of this mountain. Your war against the Empire is a mistake!"
"You are the one mistaken here. Our orders come from no Elf. We will investigate your claim. Men, dispose of this incompetent!"

Dhu'gna 
"YOU, go warn base! men are coming!!!"

Goh 
"You thinking that you stop Greenskin!? Ha! The Beast head be ours! No stealing man or clumsy Dwarf taking it!"
"What is this oaf rambling on about?"
Goh	"We saw shiny you wear, we saw you killing! But Empire not stop us now, we too far ahead, we have head by four moons!!"
"We are not men... We are Elves."

Goh 
"You lie! We with Elves! You not Elves... you kill Greenskin!"
"This creature must be daft, he speaks nonsense. What 'Elves' has he met?"
"Burn this village to the ground; leave no one alive!"

Peasant Gabs 
"No!! Please, I beg of you!!! Why are we to die!?"
"Gallean has spoken, we can but follow his orders, all life on this mountain must perish."

Peasant Gabs 
"But... we are not mountain dwellers, we live at its foot...and...I am sure we could be of use to you. We tend a mercenary camp near here! Surely there would be no wrong in using us for his bidding?"
"There is logic in your words. Yes, we shall spare those who will serve us. But this is not an act of mercy. Any problems and we will burn the lot of you!"

Geindall 
"Sir...bodies where found in root cellars throughout this town...the way they were dismembered...it must be Demons."
"Something is wrong... They made sure no one would smell the bodies as they came into the town. And the town itself is so clean..."

Geindall 
"SIR!!! At the edge of the town... look!"
"They lured us in here! Prepare to defend yourselves!"

Lothaire 
"Hold there, you, this is the domain of the Pilgrims, you cannot pillage this ruin! Now return to Gardharus and tell him to stop sending in his henchmen to steal what is ours!"
"You should watch your words, thief. We are Elves, not followers of this Gardharus you speak of. We are only interested in the return of our land."

Thug 
"...rest assured that Dragnhar will hear of this. The Pilgrims will avenge their fallen brothers... your god is a fool!"

Passage Guardian 
"Elves, we been waiting! We rip out your hearts like Wotan ripped out heart of Gallean!"

"Just like the Clans to let an imbecile speak for them. We know that your army has weakened from its last stupidity, it would be wise of you to join your capital's defenses; your defeat should prove a little less humiliating."

City Guard 
"The Elves have arrived! Guards! Ready yourselves!"

City Guard 
"We must not let them pass"

Geindall 
"We have control of Primera sir!"
"This marks our first victory over the Clans' domain! We should be weary though, they will surely plan a counterattack."

Geindall 
"Venusi is ours! We've but one more task to eliminate the Clans from this area!"
"The Clans are simply no match for our numbers, we will liberate this area in a mater of moments. Let us march on!"

Greimshog 
"We shall stop your killing! No more!"
"What unspeakable acts have the undead committed in this sacred place?"

Geindall 
"I have investigated the catacomb part of this temple, it is filled with corpses: Human, Dwarf and Elf alike!"
"Elf? Where did they find these bodies?"

Geindall 
"I believe they are the soldiers lost during the battle in Thelena. I do not understand how the hordes have managed to pass by us unnoticed while dragging so many corpses."

Peasant Griphit 
"The Empire will not stand idle while you massacre the people of Nevendaar! Your people are as foul as Bethrezen's beasts!"

"How dare you? We are the victims! We have been wronged repeatedly by Humans and Dwarves alike! We move as the wrath of the forest and you have brought us upon yourselves! We do noble work for a noble god!"

Grakuu 
"Ahh...flesh...from the woods? Are you still following your heartless beast? It does not matter, nothing does. Do you hear my lost brothers? Away from Bethrezen, forgotten on this filth they howl in hunger... waiting for meat to arrive..."
"All these bodies littering the area...they were emissaries from the Empire. You intercepted them before they could contact us, didn't you?"

Grakuu 
"Meat seems to dislike the removal of limbs. It even avoids us! We try to make it feel comfortable while we feast. Not long ago, a large horde of meat stopped by...they seemed impressed by our work! They were very tender."
"Your tortures will end here, Demon. We will destroy your infernal outpost, and with it, your infection."

Grakuu 
"Infernal outpost? How I wish it was...it would be more accurate to call it a prison now. So, it wishes to destroy us? I could not care less, but my brothers will surely prefer to feast."

Geintel 
"Korbach's fort is held by Gramel Wolfbane and his brother Golben, these two are legendary in this region, killing them would be a tremendous blow to the Dwarven morale. The brothers have led them through countless victories."
"It...seems to be an...Elf?? I was not informed that a faction lived here."
"Brother Elf, have you come to aid us in our quest? You would be most welcome!"

Dargermiel 
"I have come to remind you of those you have left for dead, brother! To avenge the useless deaths that we have suffered when we followed Gallean's word without any thought. You have all betrayed our race with your blind loyalty."
"This is madness! Our own dead coming back to life to hunt us down? Send a message to Serphis right now!"

Geindall 
"I bring a message sir, and this..."

Serphis 
"You say corpses have risen from their graves...to hunt us?"

Geintel 
"Look, those markings! These are victims Gallean's beast! It must have twisted their souls! Or... maybe it is Gallean himself bringing them back? Maybe the Oracle made a mistake...or is falsely leading us?"

Serphis 
"Don't be such a fool! The oracle is not at fault here! Nor is this Gallean's work! This is obviously Mortis's crafting; it would explain the sightings and the desecrations over the past months!"

Geintel 
"How can you distinguish whether or not a corpse was unearthed or rose itself? How can you be sure that this is not a message from Gallean? The beast was proof enough of what his rage could conjure!"

Serphis"Get ahold of yourself, Geintel! You are delusional! Galleon was provoked...the beast was a manifestation of his rage towards Mortis! He would not do this his own people. You'd best silence yourself before you are exiled."
Romald"Ha, I die knowing that I have fulfilled my task! The Clans will rid Nevendaar of your kind. Golben will be coming after you soon..."

Golben 
"WHAT?!?... Beaten by leaf-lickers! I disgust myself!!! This will humiliate my brother, but he will give you what you deserve!"
"Not so legendary after all, was he? We have slain Golben, this should shake the Clans quite a bit! There is but one Wolfbane left..."
Spare my men and you will be most pleased by their abilities... at your service.
My items are the best in the realm.

Gramel 
"Not now!  Why did you have to come here now? Why not later, after I had left?"
"What? Your brother's death has turned you into a coward?"

Gramel 
"You were expecting me to avenge him? Hell no! I don't want ta get killed. If I die, the queen will deliver one of her bloody sermons and bore my remaining relatives! I don't want to die with that on my conscience!"
"There is no choice in the matter, Dwarf, we follow Gallean's orders!"

Gramel 
"Then by the stone and the steel that binds this keep, I shall rattle your skulls!"
"Dear customer, I have left due to the Demons, but we are open! My conjured servant will help you!"

Breberik 
"The Elves have slain both Golben and Gramel! It...it is hopeless now, Korbach's Fort has fallen. We must fall back to Falhen Heim's keep!"
"We finally control the fort. This will provide the means to prepare an offensive directly on Falhen Heim! Call for Serphis and Geintel, let them know we are done here."
The greatest fighters of the realm have trained here.

Serphis 
"Excellent, we're now one step closer to reclaiming Falhen Heim. But I fear danger looms, we will need additional guidance before we continue. Call the oracle to join us!"

Geintel 
"The oracle! Wouldn't that be careless? We can't risk losing her!"

Serphis 
"Do you think there is an Elf here who would not lay down his life to protect her? She is safer here, with our army, than anywhere else. We need guidance, we need to be closer to Gallean, and she might even be able to free our dead brothers."

Serphis 
"There no choice Geintel...you should not put your worries on her. You should help us find a way to conquer Falhen Heim's Keep... That is where our real challenge lies."
I care not about your plans for the Pilgrims Honestly, only the money counts. Now...may I help you?

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, she is known for her intensity in battle and her courage in the face of overwhelming odds. She once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.
